acceptance_criteria.criterion: A normal orchestrator run creates a queue entry after run_start and removes it in the finally block.
A signal-interrupted run (SIGTERM/SIGINT) still unregisters via the finally block.
If register() raises before assigning entry_id, the finally block does not raise NameError.
If the process is killed (SIGKILL), the entry remains in the queue file (expected — cannot execute cleanup).
No regressions in existing CLI behavior.
